burirhat.name: Burirhat research farm
burirhat.kind: BARI Regional Agricultural Research Station · trial plot block
burirhat.how: Plot mosaic visible in Sentinel-2 seasonal composites, next to the OSM landmark ‘Burirhat Farm Shahi Mosque’ (25.8210 N, 89.2354 E). Individual treatment plots are not published, so values are block medians.

farmer.name: Burirhat north paddy (example plot)
farmer.kind: Smallholder paddy block · owner not identified
farmer.how: Selected because Sentinel-2 NDVI showed a Boro green-up (Feb–Mar), a low pre-monsoon period and an Aman green-up (Sep–Oct) in every year 2022–2025. That pattern matches Boro → fallow → Aman; the crop names are inferred, not reported by a farmer.
